title: Concrete products on a fixed closed support
statement: The ordered boundary product of [def-pur-frame-class] transports along a specified isomorphism of its zero scheme with a closed support; base change of the tuple gives a presentation of the base-changed support.

    (he : e.hom ≫ i = X.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f)) :
    IsPullback
      (q.zeroLocusSubschemeMap (Set.range f) (Set.range (fun k ↦ q.appTop (f k)))
        (by exact (Set.range_comp _ _).symm) ≫ e.hom)
      (Y.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range (fun k ↦ q.appTop (f k)))) i q
